job.name: s6_nod
job.prompt: Semi-flat illustration (NOT a photo). The pharmacist from the photo reference (same face, hair, white coat) stands behind the counter handing a box to a customer in front of her, while her head is clearly turned to the RIGHT toward a second person waiting in line a few steps behind; their eyes meet and the pharmacist gives a small friendly nod; the waiting person smiles back, relaxed. Both customers clearly visible. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters, labels or text at all.
job.meaning: занята покупателем, но взглядом и кивком даёт понять следующему, что его заметили

attempts.issue: Pharmacist should look toward the waiting customer to acknowledge them.
